_comment: Canonical JLCPCB order settings for MIDI Brain. tscircuit has no prop for surface finish or assembly side, so these live here and are copied into fab/ by `make release`. Upload the artifacts listed in docs/JLC-ASSEMBLY.md and set these options on the order page. Prototype outputs, not a fabrication release: resolve docs/acceptance.md gates and recheck all LCSC stock before paying.

assembly.sides_reason: 27 SMT placements bottom (MIDI/opto/passives) and 4 top (U5 nav, D3/D4/D5 LEDs). Bottom-only is possible if the 4 top parts are hand-soldered, but the nav switch is fiddly by hand.
All 18 SMT placements are on the bottom; THT sockets/headers are hand-soldered after SMT.
assembly.through_hole_note: No LCSC numbers in the design (generic 2.54 mm parts); source for the bench. Kept out of the SMT CPL by design.

board.acceptance_note: Confirm JLCPCB accepts a no-solder-mask both-sides FR-4 order before paying; still an open item.
